Pure comparison operator dispatch (EQ/NEQ/GT/LT/GTE/LTE) used by evalParam.

edges.reason: canPerform evaluates msg.sender against kernel ACL permissions.
initialize requires msg.sender == address(kernel) before creating permissions.
createPermission requires hasPermission(msg.sender, this, CREATE_PERMISSIONS_ROLE).
evalParam uses uint256(msg.sender) when param.id == SENDER_PARAM_ID.
time() reads block.timestamp to build timestamp permission parameters.
evalParam consumes the timestamp value for TIMESTAMP_PARAM_ID comparisons.
runScript performs a delegatecall to the executor with encoded user-controlled arguments.
protectState snapshots and re-checks kernel after the delegatecall executes.
protectState snapshots and re-checks appId after the delegatecall executes.
runScript resolves the executor contract via getExecutor.
runScript decodes the raw return data of the delegated call.
initialize marks the contract initialized via initialized().
initialize creates the CREATE_PERMISSIONS_ROLE permission through _createPermission.
createPermission gates execution on hasPermission.
createPermission forwards validated arguments to _createPermission.
grantPermissionP hashes and stores supplied params via _saveParams.
grantPermissionP sets the permission entry with the resulting params hash.
revokePermission requires the entity currently has the permission.
revokePermission clears the permission entry.
setPermissionManager delegates the state change to _setPermissionManager.
getPermissionManager reads permissionManager for the computed role hash.
getPermissionManager computes the key via roleHash.
hasPermission reads the permissions mapping for entity and ANY_ENTITY param hashes.
hasPermission delegates parameter evaluation to evalParams.
Bytes overload converts _how and re-dispatches to the uint256[] hasPermission.
_createPermission requires there is no existing permission manager.
_createPermission writes the permission entry.
_createPermission installs the initial permission manager.
_setPermission writes permissions[permissionHash(...)].
_saveParams pushes decoded Param structs into permissionParams.
evalParams starts recursive evaluation at param index 0.
evalParam routes LOGIC_OP_PARAM_ID params to evalLogic.
evalParam performs final comparison via compare.
evalParam reads permissionParams[_paramsHash] entries.
evalLogic recursively evaluates sub-parameters through evalParam.
_setPermissionManager writes permissionManager[roleHash(_app,_role)].
canPerform consults kernel.hasPermission when the kernel address is set.
canPerform uses inline assembly to force-cast and re-length the params array.
initialized writes the current block number into initializationBlock.
initialized obtains the block number via getBlockNumber.
_permissionsCreator is granted CREATE_PERMISSIONS_ROLE during initialize.
_entity is written into the permission entry created by createPermission.
_app scopes the permission created by createPermission.
_role selects which permission is created by createPermission.
_manager becomes the permission manager set by createPermission.
_sender is the subject evaluated for permissions in canPerform.
_script drives executor selection inside runScript.
_how is the raw bytes parameter blob decoded by hasPermission.
executorAddr is the delegatecall target resolved inside runScript.
calldataArgs is the encoded payload passed to the delegatecall in runScript.
intsLength is computed from _how.length before the forced memory cast.
paramsHash selects EMPTY_PARAM_HASH or the _saveParams result in grantPermissionP.
whoParams stores the entity-specific params hash in hasPermission.
anyParams stores the ANY_ENTITY params hash in hasPermission.
